title: From Interpretability to Control: Insights from Six Years of the TrustNLP Workshop

bias_targets.methodology: Quantitative topic analysis and literature review of 144 TrustNLP workshop proceedings papers, classifying works under the 'Fairness & Bias' dimension to track longitudinal research trends in bias measurement and mitigation.
Synthesizing findings from workshop papers that measured cross-linguistic gender bias in Wikipedia corpora and evaluated the methodology of measuring bias in word embedding spaces.
Synthesizing findings from workshop papers that explored explicit disability biases in sentiment analysis and toxicity detection models.
Synthesizing findings from workshop papers that examined representational harms, abuse detection targeting marginalized groups, and the causal impact of name-based effects on language models.
